newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish PZU Zycie gross premiums rise 30 pct in '96.
newsitem.headline: Polish PZU Zycie gross premiums rise 30 pct in '96.

text.p: Polish life insurer Powszechny Zaklad Ubezpieczen na Zycie SA (PZU Zycie) gross premium rose to 2.15 billion zlotys in 1996, according to preliminary data, up from 1.62 billion last year, the firm said in a statement.
It said its revenues from investments amounted to 501.8 million zlotys and damages paid totalled 1.2 billion zlotys.
It did not give any other figures.
The company, a subsidiary of Polish largest non-life insurance firm, the state-owned PZU SA has 77.6 percent of Polish life insurance market.
